Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with a blinding headache for a few days.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I've been having this, blinding headache for a few days.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache began suddenly upon waking.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, it just started all of a sudden. I woke up one morning with a headache,

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache duration is three days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: and that was three days ago, and I just keep having it.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is present continuously.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Kinda all the time.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Ibuprofen provides only partial relief; the headache does not fully resolve.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Doesn't really go away with Ibuprofen either, I try that, but it just. It gets a little bit better but like, doesn't go away.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is diffuse but worse over the right eye.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's kind of all over but, I feel like over my right eye, it's um bit, stronger.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports sensitivity to light (photophobia).
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, lights definitely make me more sensitive. Like, um, I don't really, like strong lights.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports visual disturbances described as shooting lights and weird vision.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
yeah, vision I think, I get this, shooting light sometimes.
Um, not sure how to explain it. Just a bit of um, weird kind of vision.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports nausea without vomiting.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Uh, no, feeling a bit sick, but no vomiting.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies tingling, numbness, or weakness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Any tingling? Or numbness? Or weakness anywhere?
Patient: Um, no.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies changes in smell or taste.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Any change in your smell or taste?
Patient: No, none at all.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Rates pain up to 8 out of 10.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I guess it's mostly, eight,

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Pain sometimes decreases to about 5 out of 10.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: and then it kinda comes down to maybe a five.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Sleeping well despite the headache.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, yeah, I'm, sleeping well.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache does not wake the patient from sleep at night.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Is it waking you up in the night-time?
Patient: No, no, no.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient can wake up with the headache in the morning.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: But I can wake up with it in the morning.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Standing up quickly can trigger a brief stabbing pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sometimes when I stand up, quickly I get a bit of a, stabbing pain.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Head movement can exacerbate the headache sensation.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: or if I throw my head like, it I kind of feel like something is moving inside.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Recent eye check reported no change in vision.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, yeah, actually had one recently and, nothing changed my vision.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies recent cold symptoms, sore throat, sore ears, or sinus pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: And have you had any cold symptoms, sore throat, sore ears, or pain over the sinuses?
Patient: No, no.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies cough or phlegm.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Any cough or flem?
Patient: No, no.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies nosebleeds.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: No. Any, any nose bleeds, or coughing up any blood or anything?
Patient: No.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies coughing up blood.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: No. Any, any nose bleeds, or coughing up any blood or anything?
Patient: No.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No recent weight change.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, no change of weight,

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports lack of energy and difficulty with daily activities due to the constant headache.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: maybe um, lack of energy but it might be because, I'm just having these headaches. so I'm find it quite difficult to go through my daily activities , you know when you have this constant headache.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache causes difficulty focusing and inability to work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: and it's like, really bothering me and , I find it very hard to focus or, like I can't even go to work.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Missed one full day of work and stopped working mid-morning on another day due to headache.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: the second I just took the whole day off. And, today I just tried to work from home the first half of the day but, I, I just stopped in the morning 'cause, I couldn't focus.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: History of intermittent headaches in the past.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Not really just they're, on and off.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: A recent prior headache lasted about two days and resolved with ibuprofen.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I recently had a, a one for like two days, um, but it just went away with Ibuprofen,

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Prior headaches were described as pressure between the eyes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's just um, a bit of a pressure, in between my eyes,

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Previously did not have visual symptoms, nausea, or vomiting with headaches.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Did you have any visual symptoms? Flashing lights? Nausea, vomiting with them?
Patient: No.
Patient: No, no.
Patient: No nothing, none of those.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No fever measured and does not feel feverish.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: But you haven't had a high temperature. Have you checked your temperature?
Patient: Uh, no I didn't, I don't really feel, feverish or anything.

Past_Medical_History.content: No significant past medical problems reported other than an unspecified pain in youth that resolved without a cause found.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: Um, I think I only had a, a pain, um, when I was younger but, no causes found and that went away, but that's, the only thing I know of.

Past_Medical_History.content: Blood pressure was checked at a pharmacy about a year ago and was reported normal.
Past_Medical_History.source_text:
yeah, I had it checked in the pharmacy when I got the pill, and they say it was normal.
Doctor: And when was that?
Patient: Uh, a year ago.

Medications.content: Patient takes an oral contraceptive pill.
Oral contraceptive pill was started about a year ago.
No side effects reported from the contraceptive pill.
Medications.source_text:
Any side effects with that?
Patient: Uh, no I don't think so.

Medications.content: No increase in headache frequency since starting the contraceptive pill.
Medications.source_text:
Have you noticed any, any um, increased frequency of headaches since you started that?
Patient: Um, no, , these headaches just very recently, but nothing um, but nothing really changes.

Medications.content: Uses ibuprofen intermittently for headache relief.
Medications.source_text: no apart from the Ibuprofen that I take, sometimes when, the headache gets really bad, nothing else.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text:
Doctor: OK. Um, and any allergies to anything?
Patient: No.

Family_History.source_text: my mum, suffers from, like she has migraines, um.

Family_History.content: Mother's migraines are severe and associated with vomiting.
Family_History.source_text: my mum like, she has quite bad migraines, she's like, has the vomiting and everything, .

Patient: Uh, no.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Consumes alcohol approximately once a week.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Um, probably like, three , once a week.

Doctor: OK. Have you been abroad recently at all?
Patient: No.

Assessment.source_text: Um, I mean it, it, it could possibly be a migraine type headache.

Plan_of_Care.content: Book an appointment for in-person examination.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: we probably should, book you into an appointment to get an examination.

Plan_of_Care.content: Perform a neurological examination and an examination of the back of the eyes.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: But we should do a neurological examination, look at the back of your eyes as well.

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribe a stronger NSAID alternative to ibuprofen.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I can prescribe you something, similar to Ibuprofen, but a bit stronger which you can take instead of Ibuprofen.

Plan_of_Care.content: Recommend taking paracetamol at the same time as the anti-inflammatory.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: And you can also take Paracetamol at the same time.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise taking the prescribed medication with food.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: And start, the medication which I prescribe to you, take it with food.

Plan_of_Care.content: Check blood pressure at the examination to review contraceptive pill suitability.
Plan_of_Care.source_text:
And when, when you have a, an examination with us, we'll check your blood pressure as well.
Just to, make sure your pill's still appropriate for you,

Plan_of_Care.content: Current contraceptive pill may need to be changed if migraines with flashing lights occur; continue current pill for now.
Plan_of_Care.source_text:
that pill if you were having , regular migraines with um, flashing lights, or , other symptoms. It wouldn't be suitable to stay on that pill, particularly, we'd have to change it to something else.
But you can carry on with that for the moment.

Follow_up_Information.content: If the headache becomes unbearable, worsens, or changes before the appointment, go to A&E.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if in the meantime before your appointment your, headache is getting unbearable, getting worse or changing. Then , um, if it's that bad, then you should go to A and E and have an examination.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient may call the clinic for further advice if needed.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Um, , you can call us for further advice on that.

Follow_up_Information.content: If symptoms settle before the appointment, the appointment can be cancelled.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: obviously , if it settles, in the meantime then, we can cancel that.
